title: feat(automation): hold, arm and run flows by (package, name), so two packages' same-named flows are each armed
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VJA2pfbBEX2uhVvw1fMXAa)_

Part of #31696

ADR-0150 child B (flow family), PR-1 of 3 (seat ruling Q1 A, 2026-11-10): the engine holds, arms and runs flows by `(package, name)`, and the stored run and credential rows (R8/R9) name their package. PR-2 binds the four trigger packages and the inbound hook per slot. PR-3 adds the `/automation` doors, the switch (`NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES += 'flow'`), dogfood and `Fixes #31696`. This PR does not touch `bare-name-one-holder.ts`. Claim by `domain:server#1`, card-thread session_01ADHkmS1tRTDQ8hmdoqUFuT.

Narrowing: no
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

**Measured values.** The claim's `Metadata-protocol: added` belongs to the switch in PR-3. This PR changes nothing an author can write: install still refuses a second holder of a flow name, because the switch is not flipped. The only state it reaches is a sealed clash, where two packages ship one name. That state moves from "arming neither" to "both armed, and the bare name is refused naming both", which is the declared widening (it reverses #31754's line, as carry-in 1 asks). A name with one holder keeps every key, log line and answer, byte for byte. Nothing that main accepts is refused here.

**Epic red line 1 is proved in this PR.** The test `red line: a package-less disable row on P1:F still holds after P2:F arrives — P1:F does not run` checks two things. First, a package-less disable row on P1:F is bound to P1 when P2:F registers, so P1:F does not run and P2:F does. Second, a restarted engine reads the durably bound row (`setActive({ name, packageId: P1, active: false })`) and P1:F still does not run. Ablation A6 below turns it red.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：自动化引擎按「(包, 名称)」持有、启用和运行流程。两个包的同名流程现在各自启用，不再一个都不启用。挂起的运行和流程凭据的存储行带上了包。
- 为什么改：这是 ADR-0150 子卡 B（flow 家族）的第一步。命名空间开关（PR-3）翻开之前，引擎必须先能并存同名流程，而且不能替调用方挑一个。
- 风险与回滚：名称只有一个持有者时，键、日志和返回都与改前逐字节相同。不带包名调用两包同名的流程会得到 409，并列出两个包，绝不替调用方挑。回滚直接 revert。
- 先看：`flow-slots.ts`（槽位与键），`engine.ts` 的 `placeFlowSlot` / `resolveFlowKey` / `bareFlowKey`，以及 `flow-slots-per-package.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/services/service-automation && npx vitest run src/flow-slots-per-package.test.ts src/flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts`（应为 2 个文件，全部通过）。
- 需要你做的：无。由席位评审、落地。

## What changes

- **`flow-slots.ts`** (new): `FlowSlot` and `FlowSlotTable`.
  - A slot is `(packageId | null, name)`. Its key is the bare name while it is the name's only slot, and `PACKAGE/NAME` (`qualifiedFlowKey`) while two or more slots hold the name.
  - `add` and `remove` return the keys that moved.
  - A package arriving for a name held by a package-less slot adopts that slot (D4: a package-less body over a package-held name customizes that holder). So a package-less slot never sits beside a package slot.
  - A run's context carries its slot key in a symbol (`FLOW_RUN_SLOT_KEY`), so a `subflow` or `map` child resolves names from its own package.
- **`engine.ts`**: every per-flow record is filed under the slot key, and `registerFlow` places each arm in a slot (`placeFlowSlot`).
  - When a second holder arrives, the first holder's records move to its qualified key: the body, shadowing, status switch, version history, policy and subflow decline records, and suspended runs. They move back when the second holder leaves.
  - **Bare doors** (`execute`, `getFlow`, `toggleFlow`, `unregisterFlow`, `withdrawFlow`, `getFlowVersionHistory`, `rollbackFlow`): a bare name with two holders gets `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`) naming both holders. There is never a pick.
  - **Slot doors** serve each holder: `executeSlot`, `getFlowSlot`, `getFlowSlots`, `flowSlotKey`, `toggleFlowSlot`, `withdrawFlowSlot`, `packagedFlowSlotOwner`.
  - `subflow` and `map` targets resolve a shared name from the caller's package, through the D3 resolver. With no resolver attached, only the caller's own slot answers. Otherwise the call is refused.
  - **E1 (#31677) is kept for every arm that names no slot.** Only precedence's per-package winners carry `holder` and arm beside each other.
  - **Triggers** still bind by bare name until PR-2. A slot whose name another package holds is not handed to a trigger: one warning per slot, and it runs when its package calls it.
- **`flow-precedence.ts`**: when two or more packages ship a name (confirmed by `packagedFlowOwner(name, pkg) === pkg`), precedence ranks each package's contenders separately and returns one winner per package (`FlowPrecedenceWinner.holder`). An environment body or row over such a name overlays neither package. It is not armed, and one warning names the holders.
- **`plugin.ts`**: the boot pull, resync, `kernel:ready` bind and mutation sync track slot identities and use `withdrawFlowSlot` / `getFlowSlot`. The packaged-flow reader takes an optional package (`shippedArtifactsOf`).
- **Activation ledger (`flow-activation-projection.ts`, `flow-definitions.ts`)**:
  - For a shared slot, only that package's own row decides.
  - A package-less row overlays neither holder, with one warning (seat ruling Q4 A).
  - `bindPackageless` binds a package-less row to the name's only holder before a second holder arrives. The engine also writes it durably as the holder's own row (epic red line 1).
- **R8, `sys_automation_run.flow_package`**: `SuspendedRun` and `RunRecord` gain `flowPackage`. The engine sees the store through `flow-slot-run-store.ts`, a lazy proxy that maps `key ↔ (flow_name, flow_package)`. A stored run resumes on its own package's flow, never on another package's flow of that name. `run-resume.ts` and `dag-traversal.ts` stamp the slot.
- **R9, `sys_flow_credential.flow_package`**: the channel's index is `name → package → positions`. Inserts are stamped with the name's one holder, and reads filter by package when given one. A two-holder name's insert carries no package, so it serves neither slot: this fails closed, and PR-2 completes the writer.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`declinesStoredRow`)**: a stored flow row is now judged against every package that ships the name, not only the first shipper the by-name lookup finds. Before, a package's declared `.custom` override was dropped at `kernel:ready` whenever another same-named shipper registered first.
- **`index.ts`**: exports `qualifiedFlowKey` and `type FlowSlot`.

**New public names (seat's call, accepted on the card):** `FlowSlot`, `FlowSlotTable`, `qualifiedFlowKey`, `executeSlot`, `getFlowSlot`, `getFlowSlots`, `flowSlotKey`, `withdrawFlowSlot`, `toggleFlowSlot`, `packagedFlowSlotOwner`, `FlowContender.holder`, `FlowPrecedenceWinner.holder`, `SuspendedRun.flowPackage` / `RunRecord.flowPackage`. Error: the existing `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` family (409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, reason `ambiguous-in-environment`). No new code.

**Declared limits (until PR-2 / PR-3):**
- Triggers decline a shared slot (PR-2).
- `flowDispatchHolder` and `flowHolder` are unchanged (PR-2).
- `ExecutionLog`, `listRuns` and `getFlowRuntimeStates` list one row per slot. A shared slot's run carries the slot key, and runtime states carry the bare name. Ruling Q2 A applies: the seat files the spec follow-up.
- The S4 report does not list Q4 overlays yet (PR-3).

## Tests

- **`flow-slots-per-package.test.ts`** (new, 22 tests) covers:
  - the `FlowSlotTable` unit, and byte identity for a unique name;
  - both holders armed and served through `executeSlot`;
  - the bare refusal at every door, with and without a resolver;
  - a subflow resolving from the caller's package;
  - the move back after a withdraw;
  - an environment body that overlays neither, and E1 kept for an arm with no slot;
  - the trigger decline;
  - the ledger red line (in memory and after a restart), the `''` row overlaying neither, and `toggleFlowSlot` writing only its own row;
  - R8: a replica resumes P2's run on P2's flow, and the red line that P2's run never continues on P1's flow;
  - the run-store view unit, the R9 channel unit, and the engine asking the channel by package;
  - precedence: one winner per package, the environment overlay, and the legacy one-argument reader.
- **Forced test edit:** `flow-declared-override-first-boot-pull.integration.test.ts`. The `#31754` describe asserted "arming neither". That line is exactly what this card reverses, so the describe is rewritten as `[#31696] … each package's flow is armed in its own slot`. Its six cases now assert slot labels at the pull and after `kernel:ready`, no refusal or collision, the bare `execute` refused naming both, `getFlow` rejecting `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, and no trigger binding. A new case pins the legacy-row overlay warning. The CONTROL case is unchanged.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, on commit `d2ef3af0`, whose ablated lines are byte-identical at head `77fa2e35`; every one red, then restored with blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):

| # | Put back | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | bare door picks the first holder (`bareFlowKey` and `flowCallKey`) | 7 (the bare-refusal red line and six boot-pull cases) |
| A2 | `resolveFlowKey` picks instead of refusing | 1 (no-resolver red line) |
| A3 | trigger binds a shared slot | 1 (trigger decline) |
| A4 | drop E1 for an arm with no slot | 1 (E1 kept) |
| A5 | run store reads a stored run by bare name | 2 (R8 resume, and the red line that P2 never continues on P1) |
| A6 | `bindPackageless` does not bind | 1 (**epic red line 1**) |
| A7 | shared slot read by the old by-name rule | 2 (`''` overlays neither, and per-slot switch) |
| A8 | `declinesStoredRow` judged against the first shipper only (metadata-protocol rebuilt) | 1 (declared override, second package registered first) |

## Verification

All runs were under `os-verify-lock.sh`, VERDICT command-exit 0. The full suites ran on `d2ef3af0`. The head `77fa2e35` differs from it only by explicit `Map<…>` annotations on five receivers and by two unused write verbs dropped from one test double; those two gate fixes were re-measured with the targeted suites below.

- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` vitest: Test Files 331 passed, 5 skipped. Tests 22654 passed, 29 skipped.
- `@objectstack/service-automation` vitest: Test Files 271 passed (271). Tests 3584 passed (3584).
- At head: `eslint packages/services/service-automation packages/metadata-protocol --no-inline-config` exit 0; `typecheck` exit 0 in both packages; the five touched test files 5/5, Tests 158/158.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 75 commands) at head `77fa2e35`: all 75 exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The first round caught two findings, both fixed at head: `check-tenant-audit-census` could not read five new `Map.delete` receivers, and `check:engine-double-contract` read the R9 test's read-only data engine as an unpinned double. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched (shallow clone).
- CI runs the full farm on this PR.
